title: Trade WBTC - Open App
meta_description: trade wbtc on Ethereum via the Uniswap app; verify the WBTC contract, review route details, and connect only on app.uniswap.org.
hero_h2: Swap into Wrapped Bitcoin on Ethereum
hero_lead: trade wbtc opens the Uniswap app for Wrapped Bitcoin on Ethereum, with contract checks, route details, price impact, and wallet confirmation before signing.
what_is: WBTC is the Wrapped Bitcoin ERC-20 token on Ethereum, designed as a Bitcoin-backed representation for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi apps; see the wrapped tokens whitepaper.

how.d: Use the primary button to open app.uniswap.org and confirm the domain before connecting a wallet.
Select Ethereum mainnet and verify WBTC contract 0x2260FAC5E5542a773Aa44fBCfeDf7C193bc2C599.
Check the input asset, route, price impact, slippage setting, and estimated network cost.
Approve only if needed, then confirm the swap from your wallet after the app details match your intent.

points.p: WBTC brings a BTC-denominated asset into Ethereum applications while remaining an ERC-20 token.
Verify the token address on Etherscan before using any swap route.
The app flow keeps the final decision in your wallet: review approvals, gas, and the exact asset before signing.

faq.q: How do I trade wbtc safely?
faq.a: Open the official app domain, verify the WBTC contract, review the quote and price impact, and sign only after your wallet shows the expected assets.

faq.q: Can I trade wbtc on Ethereum?
faq.a: Yes. WBTC is an ERC-20 token on Ethereum; the mainnet contract is listed on Etherscan.

faq.q: Do I need BTC to trade wbtc?
faq.a: No. You can swap from supported Ethereum assets; minting or redeeming BTC through WBTC merchants is a separate process from a DEX swap.

faq.q: Is trade wbtc the same as buying Bitcoin?
faq.a: No. WBTC is a wrapped representation of BTC on Ethereum, so it carries token, custodian, liquidity, and wallet risks in addition to BTC price exposure.

faq.q: What should I check before I trade wbtc?
faq.a: Check the URL, wallet network, token address, route, price impact, approvals, and that you have enough ETH for gas.

footer_note: Not the official WBTC or Uniswap app; verify app.uniswap.org before connecting; educational content only, not financial advice.
